instruction_en: Make the kitten raise its front paws, touch the object on the left, and make a gesture as if to knock it over.
pe_input_instruction: Re-pose the fluffy kitten sitting on the round white marble table so that it raises its front paws and extends one paw to touch the rolled marble-patterned object lying on the left side of the tabletop, placing the paw on the object in a gesture as if to knock it over. Adjust only the kitten's front legs and paws: the extended paw makes visible contact with the rolled object while the other front paw stays planted on the tabletop, and the kitten's reflection in the round mirror behind must match the new pose. Keep the kitten's head turned toward the camera, its fluffy cream coat with seal-brown patches on the back, the dark tabby markings on its head and ears, and its striped tail draped over the table edge exactly as they are. Keep the rolled object's position and appearance, the round white marble tabletop, the gold table legs, the round gold-framed mirror, the white brick wall background, and the scene's warm lighting, shadows, and reflections completely unchanged.

instruction_en: Remove the yellow duck kayak
pe_input_instruction: Remove the entire yellow inflatable duck kayak floating in the center of the pool — the yellow duck head with the orange beak and black printed eyes, the yellow body tube, and the yellow tail — and fill the vacated area with a seamless continuation of the pool water, its ripple pattern, and natural reflections. Keep the black-and-white dog floating naturally on the water surface at its current position, with the waterline meeting the fur naturally and a soft reflection beneath it, while maintaining the dog's current lying pose, head position, erect ears, black-and-white fur pattern, and expression looking at the camera. Keep all other elements completely unchanged: the pool water and its ripples, the tree trunk and green foliage on the left, the banana plants, the wooden fence, the bench on the left, the metal railing, the pavilion with the roof on the right, the benches and tables beneath the pavilion, the sky, and the overall bright sunny lighting.
